INSERT INTO "task_master_project_b" (
    id, -- The actual Smartsheet Row ID
    "Task id", "Task Name", "Assigned To", "Status", "Percentage Complete", 
    "Start", "Finish", "Baseline Start", "Baseline Finish", 
    "Baseline Start2", "Baseline Finish2", "Duration", "Equipment", 
    "Supporting Resource", "Critical", "Allocation %", 
    "Allocation % (Supporting resource 1)", "Assigned to (Allocation %)", 
    "Predecessors", "Variance", "Variance2", 
    "Desing Updates/Reworks", "FW", "Units Timeline", "Comments"
)
VALUES (
{{ $json._metadata.rowId }}, -- Maps Smartsheet internal ID to DB Primary Key
    '{{ $json["Task id"] }}', 
    '{{ $json["Task Name"] }}', 
    '{{ $json["Assigned To"] }}', 
    '{{ $json["Status"] }}', 
    '{{ $json["Percentage Complete"] }}', 
    {{ $json["Start"] ? "'" + $json["Start"] + "'::timestamp" : "NULL" }}, 
    {{ $json["Finish"] ? "'" + $json["Finish"] + "'::timestamp" : "NULL" }}, 
    {{ $json["Baseline Start"] ? "'" + $json["Baseline Start"] + "'::timestamp" : "NULL" }}, 
    {{ $json["Baseline Finish"] ? "'" + $json["Baseline Finish"] + "'::timestamp" : "NULL" }}, 
    {{ $json["Baseline Start2"] ? "'" + $json["Baseline Start2"] + "'::timestamp" : "NULL" }}, 
    {{ $json["Baseline Finish2"] ? "'" + $json["Baseline Finish2"] + "'::timestamp" : "NULL" }}, 
    '{{ $json["Duration"] }}', 
    '{{ $json["Equipment"] }}', 
    '{{ $json["Supporting Resource"] }}', 
    {{ $json["Critical"] }}, 
    '{{ $json["Allocation %"] }}',
    '{{ $json["Allocation % (Supporting resource 1)"] }}',
    '{{ $json["Assigned to (Allocation %)"] }}',
    '{{ $json["Predecessors"] }}',
    '{{ $json["Variance"] }}',
    '{{ $json["Variance2"] }}',
    '{{ $json["Desing Updates/Reworks"] }}',
    '{{ $json["FW"] }}',
    '{{ $json["Units Timeline"] }}',
    '{{ $json["Comments"] }}'
  )
